title: Review pipeline: derive the finding's line from a quoted snippet, repair mechanical malformation, price the round

AC1.note: locate-ingest.test.ts: a finding reporting line 99 whose quote sits on line 3 is recorded at 3, with 99 kept in locator.reported_line

AC2.note: locate-ingest.test.ts: absent quote, absent file and ambiguous quote each record line:null with their own reason

AC3.note: repair-ingest.test.ts: five findings with no id ingest cleanly as F-001..F-005; problem carried from title; manifest.repairs records both

AC4.note: repair.test.ts drives a mutating array through the repair: writing class_scope or changing the finding count is refused by name

AC5.note: cost-cli.test.ts: estimate at scope, manifest.cost at ingest, per-finding at complete; an unreported round prints "not recorded", never 0

AC6.note: decisions.md D1: declined, with 307/848 multi-file class_scope measured, the limits of that measurement, and the condition that reopens it

AC7.note: review-orchestrator SKILL.md + reviewer-finding.schema.json + review-layout SKILL.md require the quote; no scope or severity rule touched; skill-length ratchet held

AC8.note: decisions.md D0: 761 findings audited, 474 anchors resolve, 108 name an absent file, 0 past end; flow 260's own 15 all resolve. Criterion revised before freeze with the reason kept

AC9.note: bun test 10298 pass / 19 skip / 0 fail; tsc clean; lint clean
